question: Why is the division of kalā and related material included in the chapter on the revelation of seals?
premises: The division of kalā is declared in the full revelation of the seals.
From the thirty-two principles up to Īśa, the matter is clearly manifest there.
Clear manifestation in that context makes a separate treatment unnecessary.
inference: The division of kalā is treated within the revelation of seals because it becomes fully clear in that same exposition.
uncertainties: The exact scope of dvātriṃśatattva in this doctrinal sequence may depend on the thirty-second chapter.
plain_english: The division of kalā is declared in the full revelation of the seals, because from the thirty-two principles up to Īśa it becomes clearly manifest there.
